inputs.name: max_fetches
inputs.description: Batch size: 0 = all selected stocks, a positive value continues after the committed cursor

inputs.name: request_sleep
inputs.description: Seconds between request starts of one worker lane

inputs.name: concurrency
inputs.description: Parallel workers (each with its own request lane)

inputs.name: tickers
inputs.description: Ticker allowlist separated by spaces, commas or semicolons (blank in the config = every stock on the exchanges)

inputs.name: market_cap
inputs.description: Market cap range in USD (min:max, K/M/B/T suffixes allowed)

inputs.name: skip_yahoo
inputs.description: true keeps the published market data and refreshes SEC fundamentals only

inputs.name: verbose
inputs.description: true prints per-stock retry and fallback notices

inputs.name: performance_ytd
inputs.description: Price change YTD range in percent (min:max)

inputs.name: total_return_ytd
inputs.description: Total return YTD range in percent (min:max)
